subject: Brightlane renewal + capacity increase — MSA & order form redlines
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@brightlane.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase: Brightlane / Redwood

Hi Olga,

Hope you’re well. Brightlane is preparing our annual budget and we want to lock in a renewal with Redwood ahead of the new year. High-level asks:

- Move from month-to-month to a 24-month term starting 2029-12-01.
- Uplift committed capacity ~2x across inference tokens and dedicated pool seats (we can provide usage baseline).
- Request updated Order Form and MSA with redlines focused on data retention, audit rights, and liability cap.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the paper and an estimated turnaround for a first-pass redline? I’ve attached our initial MSA redline for your legal team to review.

Attachments: Brightlane_MSA_redline_v1.docx (docx)

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Head of Procurement | Brightlane
maria.gomez@brightlane.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@brightlane.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-10-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase: Brightlane / Redwood

Thanks Maria — appreciate the heads up and the redline. Looping in Ben (account lead) and Laura (legal ops) to shepherd paper.

Couple quick clarifying questions to help prioritize:
- Do you want the 24-month term to be backdated to 2029-11-01 or start 2029-12-01?
- Is the 2x uplift a hard commit or staged (e.g., 1.5x initial, +0.5x after Q1 measurement)?
- Any specific compliance deliverables beyond the SOC 2 report (e.g., encryption at rest KMS, audit log retention > 12 months)?

We’ll aim to produce an internal-first draft of the MSA redline + updated order form within 7 business days after we confirm the uplift timing.

—Olga

Date: 2029-10-03T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal + capacity increase: Brightlane / Redwood

Thanks — initial notes below. I created a draft order form for pricing and capacity bands (attached). Proposed commercial shape: 24mo term starting 2029-12-01, staged uplift: 1.5x initial effective 2029-12-01, automatic +0.5x on 2029-04-01 if usage baseline exceeded. Pricing blended across the term, with early-bird discount if signed before 2029-11-15.

Key asks for legal to incorporate in the order form/MSA:
- Confirm indemnity/liability cap language consistent with enterprise playbook
- SLA credit clarity for dedicated pool latency SLOs and fallbacks
- Data residency / retention window (they mentioned audit logs)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-10-10T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal + capacity increase: Brightlane / Redwood

Ben — see legal ops notes below (high level first-pass). I’ve reviewed Brightlane_MSA_redline_v1 and the draft order form. I’ve focused on language we typically push back on and suggested alternatives we can live with.

1) Liability cap: Brightlane proposes removing carveouts; we should keep exception for gross negligence/willful misconduct and IP infringement. Recommend: single cap = greater of (1x annual fees, $5M) with carveouts for breach of confidentiality and willful misconduct.

2) Indemnity: keep mutual IP indemnity narrow; push to exclude third-party open-source claims unless caused by Redwood modifications.

3) Data retention & audit: their redline requests 24-month audit log retention. Ops impact — we can offer 12-month retention for audit logs and 90 days for KV/cache unless they want an add-on. For SOC2 evidence (2028 report) we’ll attach the report and offer on-site audit with reasonable notice and scope limits.

4) Termination & migration assistance: if they request a 60-day termination for convenience we should limit to paid-up obligations and offer 90-day migration assistance (with fees for extended migration support).

5) SLA / credits: ensure credit calculation excludes performance degradation caused by customer data patterns or force majeure.

6) Encryption/KMS: we can support customer-managed keys for encryption at rest (enterprise add-on) — flag as optional.

Next steps: I’ll produce a marked MSA with counter-language and a redlined order form by 2029-10-14. Need clarification on their desired retention windows and the final uplift timing.

Laura Bennett
Legal Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@brightlane.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@brightlane.com>
Date: 2029-10-18T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase: Brightlane / Redwood

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few counterpoints from Brightlane Legal below (see attached Brightlane_MSA_redline_v2 for tracked changes):

- Term: we can accept a 24-month firm term starting 2029-12-01.
- Liability cap: we cannot agree to the $5M floor; propose 2x annual fees (we’ll provide forecast) — willing to discuss an exception for gross negligence.
- Audit logs: we need 18 months retention for audit logs. 90 days for KV cache is acceptable as a minimum if there is a paid retention add-on.
- SLA credits: want credits to be refundable (not merely account credit) for uptime misses above 5% over a quarter.
- KMS: we want customer-managed KMS for the dedicated pool; please confirm technical and cost implications.

Forwarding Brightlane_MSA_redline_v2.docx (docx). We can do a legal call next week to resolve remaining items; Maria, Samir available Thurs/Fri.

Regards,
Samir Khan
Sr. Counsel | Brightlane
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@brightlane.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@brightlane.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-10-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase: Brightlane / Redwood — agreed path forward

Maria / Samir — thanks for the feedback and the V2 redline. Summary / proposed path to signature: 

1) Commercial: 24-month term starting 2029-12-01; staged uplift (1.5x on day 1, +0.5x on 2029-04-01 subject to usage baseline). Ben to finalize pricing table and include early-sign discount.

2) Liability / indemnity: we’ll accept a compromise — liability cap = 2x annual fees (per Samir) with narrowly tailored carveouts for gross negligence and wilful misconduct. Laura will reflect this in the MSA redline.

3) Data retention & audit: offer 18 months retention for audit logs as a baseline; KV/cache retention 90 days included, extended retention available as a paid add-on. SOC2 report (attached) to be appended to the contract.

4) SLA credits: Redwood to provide payout option (refund or credit) for quarterly uptime misses >5%; cap methodology to be defined in the SLO schedule.

5) KMS / encryption: we can support customer-managed keys for the dedicated pool as an enterprise add-on. Ops will provide a runbook and cost delta.

6) Next steps & timeline: Laura will prepare the redlined MSA + updated order form and circulate by 2029-11-05. Ben to prepare the DocuSign envelope once paperwork is final (DocuSign envelope placeholder below). We’re aiming for signature before 2029-11-15 to lock the early-sign discount.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/BRIGHT-2029-10-01 | Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-brightlane-renewal | DocuSign envelope: https://account.redwood.com/docusign/envelope/ENVELOPE-987654

Attachments appended for your reference: SOC2-report-2028.pdf (pdf)

If that summary matches your expectations, I’ll ask Laura to produce the final redline and Ben will kick off DocuSign. Can we lock a legal call on 2029-11-07 10:00am PT?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference
